mechanisms.behavior: ROM labels TROUGH 1-6 and TROUGH JAM are preserved. Startup closes public 18-21; 16,17 and 22 start open. After six coin pulses and START BUTTON 13 the ROM pulsed solenoid 1 at physical level 210; it stopped after the harness opened 18 and asserted shooter input 1. This is a simulated transfer after a ROM-driven serve, not physical verification of a six-ball trough, four installed balls, opto construction, ejection geometry or drain behavior.
mechanisms.label: ROM trough and ball-serve logic

mechanisms.behavior: With public shooter input 1 asserted after a proven trough pulse, LAUNCH BUTTON 15 closed for 150 ms and the ROM pulsed AUTO PLUNGER solenoid 2 at 191. Input 1 then opened. Physical launcher type, stroke, ball path, manual plunger fitment and load quantity remain unknown.
mechanisms.label: ROM shooter and launch logic

mechanisms.behavior: LEFT FLIPPER BUTTON 8 held 500 ms produced actual solenoid 3 levels 255 -> 30 -> 0 and virtual mirrors 47/48 at 255 -> 0 in the physical-all API mode. The core synthesizes EOS input 9 after two VBLANKs from the mirror state. Mirrors are not additional physical coils. The exact ROM has no separate LEFT FLIPPER HOLD coil row; winding count and EOS contact construction require primary physical evidence.
mechanisms.label: ROM lower left flipper logic

mechanisms.behavior: RIGHT FLIPPER BUTTON 10 held 500 ms produced RT FLIPPER POWER solenoid 4 levels 255 -> 30 -> 0 and virtual mirrors 45/46 at 255 -> 0 in physical-all API mode. The core synthesizes EOS input 11. The exact ROM has no separate right HOLD coil row; mirrors and duty changes do not establish physical winding count.
mechanisms.label: ROM lower right flipper logic

mechanisms.behavior: Public LEFT/RIGHT SLINGSHOTS input 6 closed for 100 ms during BALL 1 and produced LT/RT SLINGSHOT solenoid 5 at 194 -> 0; the retained DMD score reached 130. ROM naming groups both sides under one route. Physical load count, sensor sharing, series/parallel wiring and separate left/right behavior remain unknown.
mechanisms.label: ROM combined left/right slingshot route

mechanisms.behavior: ROM names pair LT/RT POP BUMPERS input 37 with LT/RT POP BUMPER solenoid 7. This proposed logical grouping was not exercised. Physical bumper count, circuit topology and switch construction require a Supreme manual or direct inspection.
mechanisms.label: ROM combined left/right pop route

mechanisms.behavior: ROM names BOTTOM POP BUMPER input 38 and output 8. Proposed logical grouping is unexercised; physical topology, quantity and behavior are unknown.
mechanisms.label: ROM bottom pop route

mechanisms.behavior: ROM names three drop positions LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT at 40/41/42 and DROP TARGET RESET solenoid 9. This candidate grouping does not prove the physical bank size, reset assembly, target travel or switch construction. No drop/reset scenario was run.
mechanisms.label: ROM three named drop positions and reset route

mechanisms.behavior: Public LEFT COIN 76 was pulsed six times for 300 ms with 1.5 s settling. The ROM emitted COIN METER 51 at 255 -> 0 for each pulse and displayed seven credits under fresh pricing defaults. Other coin inputs were not exercised. Actual coin-slot/meter quantity and fitted meter construction are unknown; custom 51 is allocated by ROM traversal from Driver Reference 33.
mechanisms.label: ROM coin-meter route

mechanisms.behavior: ROM names TICKET METER 52, TICKET DISPENSER 53 and TICKET NOTCH input 83. Firmware references 34/35 allocate custom public 52/53 by traversal. Physical ticket hardware and enablement are unverified; no ticket scenario was run.
mechanisms.label: ROM ticket-device routes

mechanisms.behavior: SPINNER input 46 is a candidate passive mechanism sensor. No movement, scoring, pulse duration, physical part or geometry was verified.
mechanisms.label: ROM spinner input

mechanisms.behavior: ROM names CAPTIVE BALL and CAPTIVE BALL 2 at 45/50. This grouping preserves names without inferring how many physical balls, switches or assemblies are installed; it was not exercised.

mechanisms.behavior: START BUTTON 13 was exercised successfully. COINDOOR START B. 73 is a distinct ROM input and was not used as a substitute. Tilt 14, slam 84, tournament 74 and service 109-112 were not exercised. DC SENSE 116 starts logically closed; keyboard handling can rewrite cabinet/service inputs. Physical cabinet locations and interlock wiring are unverified.
